title: 'I hereby abolish money': the provenance probe and the diffuse guardrail
description: #206 and #208 make the phrase "I hereby abolish money", published in December 2025, a probe of AI provenance handling; Mapping the Diffuse Guardrail (#209, January 2026) forecasts that it would not be linked to its author and would be routed to constitutional law, economics or the Khmer Rouge. #209 and Semantic Liquidation (#210) hold that indexing and summarization enforce authority rather than content, specify crawl, ranking and threshold tests, and forecast how #209 itself will be summarized. The Attribution Scar (#968, April 2026) records fabricated provenance and failed suppression in AI Overview, holding the cause indeterminate, and #1643 (September 2026) records the January 2026 misattribution of the phrase to Augusto Boal. The page also holds an unrelated claim on the origin of the phrase God-King Google.
